# Acceptance d462b R3 (N1 mirror). A round item fails because the remote lacks its base. The base is pushed.
# beehave resume reopens the failed run and beehave run continues it: the worktree is made, the step runs, and no step is refused as out of order.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
subst flow/round.star

exec beehavereal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stderr 'base branch "integration/r1" of round item round/integration/r1'
! exists before.pwd

exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

exec sh any.sh resume resume round/integration/r1
exec sh any.sh run run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
exec cat resume.rc resume.err run.rc run.err

# CELL R3a: no recorded step of the reopened run is refused as out of order.
! grep 'UnexpectedStep' resume.err
! grep 'UnexpectedStep' run.err
! grep 'deterministic' run.err
# CELL R3b: the step ran in the worktree of the round.
exists before.marker
grep '^base marker$' before.marker
grep 'item round/integration/r1 finished' run.out

-- any.sh --
# any.sh <label> <args>: runs beehavereal with the args, keeps its output in <label>.out and <label>.err and its code in <label>.rc, and always exits 0.
label=$1
shift
beehavereal "$@" > "$label.out" 2> "$label.err"
echo $? > "$label.rc"

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "before", run = ["sh", "-c", "pwd > @WORK@/before.pwd; cat BASE_MARKER > @WORK@/before.marker"])
